summary: Golar LNG filed a Form 6-K on June 29, 2026, attaching a press release that merely announces the scheduled date and webcast details for its Q2 2026 earnings results, which will be released on August 13, 2026. There is no mention of any special situation such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. This is a routine announcement of an earnings release date and conference call logistics, which does not constitute a special situation.
